reviews.author: Julia C
reviews.text:
I can’t believe you can still find fish tacos for just $1.39 each in California!

Not only are they affordable, but they’re also absolutely delicious. The ingredients are fresh, the fish is perfectly seasoned, and every bite is packed with flavor. The tacos taste authentic, and the quality easily exceeds the price.

The food comes out quickly, the service is efficient, and the value is simply unbeatable. If you’re looking for great tacos without breaking the bank, this place is definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Steve Morales
reviews.text: $1.39 for an Awesome Fish Taco ! Had to check out it to see if it was True ! Yup .. it's True . Got to go and get your fill . The taco has 2 fresh tortillas, the fish is battered to a light and crispy crust . Cabbage and tomatoes with a nice creamy sauce. Add fresh salsa Verde or rojo from the salsa bar. Can't Beat this Deal !!

reviews.author: Jason Novik
reviews.text: $1.39 fish tacos. Places like this should be cherished! Honest restaurant with amazing prices and quality customer service. Cannot beat it! People that actually care about their food and work, and don’t just drive up prices to meet a certain quota.

reviews.author: Je S
reviews.text: Love their fish tacos and for the price, you can’t beat the deal. Great service by Arturo. The only bad thing is the lack of parking

reviews.author: Fabiana Marques
reviews.text:
Paid $22 for this burrito and chips and honestly it was one of the worst takeout experiences I’ve had. The burrito was poorly rolled, falling apart, had way too much tortilla and barely any filling inside. The food had no flavor or seasoning at all and was honestly terrible.

I called asking for a refund and they told me they would not refund my money unless I drove back there with the receipt. The problem is this was a to-go order and by the time I opened the food, I was already 20 minutes away on the freeway, so going back was not realistic.

I also asked if there was a number or email where I could send photos and make a complaint, and they basically told me there was nothing they could do and that I could leave a bad Google review if I wanted.

Terrible customer service, overpriced food, and horrible quality. I will literally never go back there again and I do not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Jane Chang Bright
reviews.text: Dude. I would give 10 stars if I could! This place was highly recommended by a friend so we came the next time we were down this way. $1.39 fish tacos and there's no limit!!! The best fish tacos I've had, hands down! They need to open one closer to me!! The Paloma was really tasty, too! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Nekaiya Wilson
reviews.text: El Pueblo is truly a gem! The prices are amazing, the customer service is always warm and welcoming, and the food comes out incredibly fast. You really can’t beat the turnaround time or the value. Misael and J are both so kind, professional, and attentive—they make the experience even better every time we visit!

reviews.author: Ethan Feron
reviews.text: Need left handed ladles for the hot sauce - all good - went for the fish tacos as always - flour better than corn (shrugs!) Went back and got elevated to “regular” status - really nice peeps work here

reviews.author: Grace Tran
reviews.text: One of our favorite go-to places!!! Love their food every time, so satisfying. We love getting their tacos and fries. Shout-out to Vanessa and Rosa for excellent service 👍🙏

reviews.author: Nelly Jacobo
reviews.text: The tacos at El Pueblo were absolutely delicious! Everything tasted fresh, flavorful, and authentic. What made our experience even better was Jermias. He was super friendly, welcoming, and helpful, and gave us excellent service. Great tacos and great service—we’ll definitely be coming back!

carmel-valley.name: El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar - Carmel Valley

reviews.author: Airick M
reviews.text:
Delicious food! Just could get pricy and you have to order on a screen.

Sounds like people for for the fish tacos I'll need to try that next time. They sound like a deal

Food 5/5
-California Burrito: it was delicious (5/5) the ingredients taste fresh and you can tell it's quality! Although one burrito came out to be $20!
-Salsa Bar: The salsas taste amazing! They have fresh salsa and they pair very well with the food!

Service 3/5
-This is where there is room for improvement. You need to order yourself on a tablet. There was no one to take an order when I went in. Also when ordering it's not very clear to what is included in the burrito when you're clicking to order. When you order it's helpful if someone is there for recommendations and clarifications.

Ambiance 5/5
-This place is well designed and in an upscale beautiful area. The inside is designed, beautiful interior with TVs if you wanted to watch sports

Overall delicious food, just wish they had people taking order and just be mindful of the price point. It has quality food and is Recommended!

reviews.author: Waleed Sharaf
reviews.text: Stopped by for lunch round 2pm and it was about 1/3 full.  Ordered food on the stand-alone kiosk and customized the order with extra protein and sauces.  Food came out in about 15min, but I couldn't see all the add-ons we paid for, which was odd.  The food was not as hot as I would've expected if it was just made fresh.  The flavor and presentation was good and the atmosphere is very casual and mainly focused on the huge bar in the middle of the restaurant. I recommend this place, but probably not get any add-ons next time and insist that the food comes out "very hot"!

reviews.author: Brandon Nolte
reviews.text: I underestimated this place. The meats were well seasoned, the taco bar was thoughtfully stocked, and the staff was warm and efficient. For the quality, it is an excellent value. The only puzzling note was the generic signage out front, which hides a spot that deserves to be known by name.

reviews.author: Doneka Clark
reviews.text:
Chicken tacos/ flour tortilla rice and beans
Chicken fajitas/flour tortillas rice and beans
Shirley temple & double Margarita with nothing on the rim.

Staff very helpful with ordering. The gentleman asked if I wanted to do order with a person or use kiosk. You order and can pick your own seat. Dine outside around the fire pit watching the game. Great atmosphere and the staff is so friendly and helpful. Will definitely dine here again.

reviews.author: Amol Birje
reviews.text: El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar in Carmel Valley was outstanding! The food was fresh, flavorful, and authentic, with something on the menu for everyone. The fish tacos and margaritas were especially delicious. The service was friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. The atmosphere was lively yet relaxed—perfect for a family dinner, date night, or catching up with friends. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend this local gem!

del-mar.name: El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar - Del Mar

reviews.author: Karina Covarrubias
reviews.text: As soon as I walked in, I could tell this place takes pride in what they do. It was super clean, organized, and just had a really good vibe. Everything looked fresh and well put together, which made me feel comfortable right away. The customer service was amazing,she explained the menu so clearly, was super sweet, and very professional the whole time. You can tell she actually cares about the customers. The food was sooo good, fresh, and full of flavor. Honestly, everything about the experience was on point. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this spot to others!

reviews.author: Chelsea Mills
reviews.text:
Had an incredible experience at El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar in Del Mar! Sitting at the bar was the highlight – the bartender, Joe, was hands down the most attentive, skilled, & genuinely kind bartender I’ve had. Watching him masterfully craft each drink was a treat. I ordered the Paloma, which was not only delicious but (as you can see here) photograph-worthy. They also have a fantastic selection of top-shelf liquors. I got the chips & guacamole/salsa combo to snack on, & everything was fresh and flavorful. (Shhhh.. the quality here far exceeds the price!)

Highly recommend stopping in – and definitely try to catch one of Joe’s shifts for an exceptional experience!

reviews.author: orlando lopez
reviews.text:
Had a great time at El Pueblo Mexican Food & Bar - Del Mar. The atmosphere was awesome good music, great energy, and a really friendly crowd. It was definitely busy, but even with that, we still had a really good experience.

The food was excellent and super affordable, especially the fish tacos they were easily the highlight. Drinks were great too, and everything just had a fun, laid-back vibe.

Overall, I’d definitely come back. It’s a great spot to hang out, eat well, and enjoy the atmosphere.

reviews.author: Tania McDonald
reviews.text: A gem near the coast with great food at great prices! Our go to for fish tacos and flautas, the best we’ve had in San Diego yet! They have other great items on the menu as well and the Dessert case always has some delicious surprises for those who love to end on a sweet note, like me! 😋

reviews.author: Seabreeze HOA
reviews.text:
This place has the BEST tacos I’ve ever eaten. Oh my word. Often carne asada is dry and chewy—not the case here.  The meat is charred to perfection and is so tender and juicy. My husband had carnitas and it was golden crisp on the outside, moist on the inside, just like it should be.

Topped with guacamole and the works, paired with super soft fresh corn tortillas, and doused with flavorful salsa that packs a punch… Two large tacos that fill you up for only $10… It really doesn’t get any better than this!!! 😍

la-jolla.name: El Pueblo Mexican Food - La Jolla

reviews.author: Chris Wood
reviews.text: This is such a nice restaurant. The prices are great and Carlos is one of the nicest person on earth. He helped me so much with my order and I am so happy that I’m gonna be here more get that one dollar 50 Cent taco

reviews.author: Zachary Watson
reviews.text: The food was very good! The service was quick and friendly which we appreciated because we had two leave groups together. The tacos were excellent and good size. The chimichanga was huge! Thank you Joey, Francisco, and Cristina!

reviews.author: nahr b
reviews.text: Good service.. good food.. thanks to Jushua he was so helpful and patient while taking the orders 😅

reviews.author: Keegan Kemp
reviews.text: Carlos is the man. Great service from the start. Good vibes. Fish tacos and carne asada tacos were fantastic and well priced! Kids loved the kids meal options. Turtle cheesecake was delicious.

reviews.author: blondie
reviews.text:
good prices without skimping on quality.
their tacos are SOO good. and huge.

would really recommend the fish tacos or the 2 for 10 and the 1.50 side special.

will be coming back !!
